legacy_cells.B: Development implementation and validation of an open-source Federated Learning platform to accelerate innovation and boost personalized medicine in rare and ultra-rare haematological diseases: an initiative by GenoMed4All Consortium
legacy_cells.C: Gianluca Asti, Patricia A. Apellániz, Luciana Carota, Francesco Casadei, Davide Piscia, Mattia Delleani, et al.
legacy_cells.I: 038_2025_Development implementation and validation of an open-source Federated Learning platform to accelerate innovation and boost personalized medicine .pdf
legacy_cells.O: Myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS); acute myeloid leukemia (AML); chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML); multiple myeloma (MM)
legacy_cells.S: Does federated training support overall-survival prediction and synthetic-data generation with performance comparable to centralized or isolated training?
legacy_cells.AI: Clinical and hematologic data; genomic features (gene mutations and MM copy-number variations); bone-marrow whole-slide-image embeddings; PET radiomic features; treatment/response data
legacy_cells.BI: DeepSurv; SAVAE; CTGAN; Bayesian Network; VAE-BGM
legacy_cells.DN: Retrospective EuroBloodNet cohorts: MDS; AML; CMML; MM
legacy_cells.DQ: MDS: 4,427 patients; AML: 1,547 patients; CMML: 1,737 patients; MM: 1,005 patients
legacy_cells.EL: Locally trained models on smaller datasets had lower predictive performance; limited per-patient information in the worst-case scenario negatively affected isolated training.
legacy_cells.EO: Federated learning keeps patient data at custodians' sites and shares model parameters rather than patient-level data; TLS encryption and role-based access control are described.
legacy_cells.EQ: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); HL7 FHIR
legacy_cells.ER: Ethics Committees of project partners approved the study; written informed consent was obtained; registered as ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04889729.
legacy_cells.FM: Developed and implemented an open-source federated-learning platform, with data harmonization and federated model training, for multimodal rare-haematological-disease use cases.
legacy_cells.FP: Broader deployment is ongoing; the authors plan prospective initiatives to validate predictive models and enable next-generation predictive tools and clinical guidelines.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors identify limited access to high-quality real-world data, privacy restrictions, fragmented infrastructures, and lack of harmonization as barriers to research in rare diseases.
legacy_cells.FR: The paper demonstrates federated infrastructure, retrospective survival-prognosis modeling, and synthetic tabular-data generation, but not a persistent patient/procedural state with learned temporal transitions, action-conditioned rollouts, counterfactual identification, or planning/control; it is not evidence of a healthcare world model.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M1 Data adapters & provenance; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Keep site-local data and provenance behind federated data adapters, with governance separate from the prediction backend.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted PDF text, pp. 1–20: title/byline and abstract (pp. 1–3); Introduction (p. 4); Methods (pp. 5–8); Results (pp. 9–11); Discussion (pp. 12–13); References (pp. 14–15); figures and tables (pp. 16–20). | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: Corrected only the prefilled title in B to match the PDF's printed title; other prefilled A:I values were left unchanged. Table 2 and portions of Table 1 are flattened in the extracted text, so no table-derived performance metric was transcribed. Classification reflects static survival-prognosis and synthetic-data methods; no temporal state-transition or planning results are demonstrated. Evidence QA: 22/28 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (78.6%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 24 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 5 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: No independent human review or code execution.
Simulated worker partitions from pooled randomsplit do not establish external institution validation.
NNDR alone does not prove privacy guarantees; numerical disclosure metrics and comprehensive attack assessment not reported.
Principal results preserved as structured raw Table2 data; per-cell validation split scope and uncertainty remain unresolved.
Research platform installations and trialregistration do not establish prospective model use or therapeutic clinical benefit.
